name: Litragon Book Club
source:
When escaping a rainstorm, an android meets a large computer server in the place they're taking shelter in. Out of boredom (and a need for companionship), the android stumbles into starting an informal book club.

[From [url=https://adairtrashart.itch.io/litragon-book-club]itch.io[/url]]
